name: Upgrade (Tractor)
description: A fixed four-seat, partnership Upgrade game with two decks, declarations, a hidden kitty, structured trick following, point capture, and level progression.

rules.table: Exactly four stable seats form two fixed partnerships by seat parity. Two standard 54-card decks deal 25 cards to each Member and leave an eight-card kitty.
rules.declaration: Each seat declares at most once with pass_declare or declare_trump. A single level card, an identical level pair, or an identical joker pair may declare; stronger declarations replace weaker ones. If all pass, the starter establishes no-trump.
rules.kitty: The declaration winner becomes declarer, takes the kitty, and buries exactly eight cards in a hidden zone before trick play.
rules.plays: A lead may be a single, identical pair, consecutive identical pairs called a tractor, or a same-effective-suit throw. Followers play the same card count and must exhaust the led effective suit while preserving available pair or tractor structure.
rules.points: Captured 5 cards score five points; 10 and K cards score ten. Defenders accumulate public points. The final trick multiplies buried kitty points by twice the lead card count.
rules.levels: Defenders below 80 points leave the declarer partnership in control; defenders at or above 80 take control. Level movement uses forty-point bands and is capped at the configured target level.
rules.privacy: Only the current Leader stores the complete deal and hidden kitty. Signed Member views reveal only that Member's hand, public tricks, counts, declarations, and scores.
rules.recovery: A Leader change preserves partnership levels and completed-hand counters, discards the private deal, and starts a fresh hand.
